description: This file contains functions for importing observations into the BORIS software from project files and spreadsheets, including handling of file dialogs, data validation, and user prompts.

methods.name: load_observations_from_boris_project
methods.description: Loads observations from a BORIS project file, handling file reading, JSON parsing, and importing selected observations with user prompts.

methods.name: load_observations_from_spreadsheet
methods.description: Imports observations from an Excel or ODS spreadsheet, validating headers and appending events to current observation.

methods.name: import_observations
methods.description: Main function to prompt user for a file and delegate to appropriate import function based on file extension.
